question:
Read the following passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.

Ayurveda, one of the oldest systems of medicine, has been practised in the subcontinent ____1____ thousands of years. Unlike modern pharmacology, which often isolates a single active compound, Ayurveda relies on a holistic approach ____2____ treats the body, mind and environment as interconnected. Its practitioners believe that illness arises when the natural balance of bodily elements is disturbed, and that restoring this balance, rather than merely suppressing symptoms, is what genuine healing ____3____. In recent decades, growing interest in natural remedies has encouraged researchers to examine these traditional formulations more rigorously, ____4____ many claims still await robust clinical validation. Governments and universities have begun to invest in laboratories that can test herbal compounds using contemporary scientific methods, so that time-tested wisdom is not simply dismissed but is instead ____5____ to standards that a sceptical, evidence-based world can accept.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. for.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• For is used with a period/duration of time ("for thousands of years") to show how long an action or state has continued, and pairs naturally with the present perfect "has been practised" (के लिए)

◦ Example: The ritual has been observed for centuries in this region.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

Additional Information

• Option 1 "since" is used with a specific starting point in time (e.g. "since 1990"), not a span of duration, so it cannot precede "thousands of years".

• Option 3 "from" would need a paired "to/till" to mark duration and does not fit alone here.

• Option 4 "during" is used with a specific named period ("during the festival"), not with a length of time expressed in numbers.

NOTE

• Remember the rule: use since with a point of time (a year, an event) and for with a duration or span of time (a number of days, years, hours).

question:
Read the following passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.

Ayurveda, one of the oldest systems of medicine, has been practised in the subcontinent ____1____ thousands of years. Unlike modern pharmacology, which often isolates a single active compound, Ayurveda relies on a holistic approach ____2____ treats the body, mind and environment as interconnected. Its practitioners believe that illness arises when the natural balance of bodily elements is disturbed, and that restoring this balance, rather than merely suppressing symptoms, is what genuine healing ____3____. In recent decades, growing interest in natural remedies has encouraged researchers to examine these traditional formulations more rigorously, ____4____ many claims still await robust clinical validation. Governments and universities have begun to invest in laboratories that can test herbal compounds using contemporary scientific methods, so that time-tested wisdom is not simply dismissed but is instead ____5____ to standards that a sceptical, evidence-based world can accept.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. that.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• That is the correct relative pronoun here because it refers back to a thing ("a holistic approach"), not a person, and introduces a restrictive relative clause defining which approach is meant (जो)

◦ Example: She proposed a plan that addressed every concern raised earlier.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

Additional Information

• Options 2 and 3 "who"/"whom" are relative pronouns used only for people, not for an abstract noun like "approach".

• Option 4 "whose" shows possession ("the approach whose method...") and does not fit the sense of "which treats" required here.

NOTE

• Use who/whom for people, which for things (usually in non-restrictive clauses after a comma), and that for both people and things in restrictive (defining) clauses.

Ayurveda, one of the oldest systems of medicine, has been practised in the subcontinent ____1____ thousands of years. Unlike modern pharmacology, which often isolates a single active compound, Ayurveda relies on a holistic approach ____2____ treats the body, mind and environment as interconnected. Its practitioners believe that illness arises when the natural balance of bodily elements is disturbed, and that restoring this balance, rather than merely suppressing symptoms, is what genuine healing ____3____. In recent decades, growing interest in natural remedies has encouraged researchers to examine these traditional formulations more rigorously, ____4____ many claims still await robust clinical validation. Governments and universities have begun to invest in laboratories that can test herbal compounds using contemporary scientific methods, so that time-tested wisdom is not simply dismissed but is instead ____5____ to standards that a sceptical, evidence-based world can accept.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. entails.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Entails means to necessarily involve or require something as a consequence, which fits the idea that genuine healing necessarily involves restoring balance (शामिल होना/आवश्यक करना)

◦ Example: Running a successful business entails careful planning and constant adaptation.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

Additional Information

• Option 2 "denotes" means to signify or be a sign of something, which does not carry the sense of necessary involvement needed here.

• Option 3 "resembles" means to look similar to, which is unrelated to the meaning of the sentence.

• Option 4 "permits" means to allow, which reverses the intended meaning of necessary requirement.

NOTE

• When a process or action necessarily involves or requires certain steps, the precise word to use is entail, not "denote" or "resemble".

question:
Read the following passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.

Ayurveda, one of the oldest systems of medicine, has been practised in the subcontinent ____1____ thousands of years. Unlike modern pharmacology, which often isolates a single active compound, Ayurveda relies on a holistic approach ____2____ treats the body, mind and environment as interconnected. Its practitioners believe that illness arises when the natural balance of bodily elements is disturbed, and that restoring this balance, rather than merely suppressing symptoms, is what genuine healing ____3____. In recent decades, growing interest in natural remedies has encouraged researchers to examine these traditional formulations more rigorously, ____4____ many claims still await robust clinical validation. Governments and universities have begun to invest in laboratories that can test herbal compounds using contemporary scientific methods, so that time-tested wisdom is not simply dismissed but is instead ____5____ to standards that a sceptical, evidence-based world can accept.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. though.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Though functions here as a subordinating conjunction meaning "although", joining a clause of contrast to the preceding statement (यद्यपि/हालांकि)

◦ Example: The bridge was completed on time, though the budget had nearly doubled.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

Additional Information

• Option 2 "moreover" adds a further supporting point and does not signal contrast, so it cannot connect two opposing ideas.

• Options 3 and 4 "thus"/"hence" indicate a result or conclusion, not a contrast, and would reverse the logical relationship intended.

NOTE

• Use though/although to join a main clause with a contrasting subordinate clause; use "thus/hence" only when the second clause is a result, not a contrast.

Unlike modern pharmacology, which often isolates a single active compound, Ayurveda relies on a holistic approach ____2____ treats the body, mind and environment as interconnected. Its practitioners believe that illness arises when the natural balance of bodily elements is disturbed, and that restoring this balance, rather than merely suppressing symptoms, is what genuine healing ____3____. In recent decades, growing interest in natural remedies has encouraged researchers to examine these traditional formulations more rigorously, ____4____ many claims still await robust clinical validation. Governments and universities have begun to invest in laboratories that can test herbal compounds using contemporary scientific methods, so that time-tested wisdom is not simply dismissed but is instead ____5____ to standards that a sceptical, evidence-based world can accept.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 1 i.e. subjected.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Subjected to is the standard collocation meaning to make something undergo a process, here the process of being tested against scientific standards (के अधीन किया गया)

◦ Example: The new alloy was subjected to rigorous stress tests before approval.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

Additional Information

• Option 2 "submitted" is normally used for a person putting forward a proposal or document, not for a thing being made to undergo scrutiny.

• Option 3 "exposed" suggests revealing something hidden or making it vulnerable, not the sense of being tested against a standard.

• Option 4 "dedicated" means devoted to a purpose and does not fit the idea of undergoing evaluation.

NOTE

• The fixed phrase is subjected to (a process/test), while "exposed to" is used for risk or danger and "submitted to" for authority or a proposal.

question:
Read the following passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.

As more of our daily transactions move online, protecting personal data ____1____ become a matter of individual responsibility as much as national policy. Cybercriminals constantly devise new methods of deception, ____2____ phishing emails and fraudulent links that mimic legitimate websites. A single careless click can allow malicious software to infiltrate a device and ____3____ sensitive information such as passwords and bank details. Experts therefore advise users to update their software regularly, avoid unfamiliar downloads, and enable two-factor authentication wherever possible. Organisations, too, must invest in firewalls and encryption ____4____ their networks remain resilient against attack. Yet technology alone cannot guarantee safety; ultimately, cybersecurity depends ____5____ the vigilance of ordinary users who must learn to recognise suspicious activity before it causes irreversible harm.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. has.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Has is the correct auxiliary for the present perfect tense ("has become"), which describes a change that started in the past and remains true now (है - वर्तमान पूर्ण काल)

◦ Example: Online shopping has become the preferred way to buy everyday goods.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

Additional Information

• Option 1 "had" forms the past perfect, used for an action completed before another past action, which does not suit this present-relevance context.

• Option 2 "is" would require "becoming" or "become" as an adjective, not the past participle construction used here.

• Option 4 "was" is a past-tense auxiliary and would incorrectly place the change entirely in the past, ignoring its present relevance.

NOTE

• Use the present perfect (has/have + past participle) for a past change whose effect continues into the present.

As more of our daily transactions move online, protecting personal data ____1____ become a matter of individual responsibility as much as national policy. Cybercriminals constantly devise new methods of deception, ____2____ phishing emails and fraudulent links that mimic legitimate websites. A single careless click can allow malicious software to infiltrate a device and ____3____ sensitive information such as passwords and bank details. Experts therefore advise users to update their software regularly, avoid unfamiliar downloads, and enable two-factor authentication wherever possible. Organisations, too, must invest in firewalls and encryption ____4____ their networks remain resilient against attack. Yet technology alone cannot guarantee safety; ultimately, cybersecurity depends ____5____ the vigilance of ordinary users who must learn to recognise suspicious activity before it causes irreversible harm.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 3 i.e. such as.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Such as is used to introduce specific examples of a preceding general category, here giving examples of "methods of deception" (जैसे कि)

◦ Example: The report lists several risk factors, such as poor diet and lack of exercise.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 3.

Additional Information

• Option 1 "despite" introduces a contrast or concession and does not fit the sense of giving examples.

• Option 2 "unless" introduces a condition and would make the sentence illogical here.

• Option 4 "whereas" signals contrast between two clauses, not an example of a category.

NOTE

• Use such as (not "like" in formal writing) to introduce specific examples of a general noun phrase already mentioned.

Cybercriminals constantly devise new methods of deception, ____2____ phishing emails and fraudulent links that mimic legitimate websites. A single careless click can allow malicious software to infiltrate a device and ____3____ sensitive information such as passwords and bank details. Experts therefore advise users to update their software regularly, avoid unfamiliar downloads, and enable two-factor authentication wherever possible. Organisations, too, must invest in firewalls and encryption ____4____ their networks remain resilient against attack. Yet technology alone cannot guarantee safety; ultimately, cybersecurity depends ____5____ the vigilance of ordinary users who must learn to recognise suspicious activity before it causes irreversible harm.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. extract.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Extract means to draw out or obtain something, which precisely describes malicious software pulling out sensitive data from a device (निकालना)

◦ Example: The scam app was designed to extract contact lists without the user's knowledge.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

Additional Information

• Option 1 "retain" means to keep or hold on to something already possessed, not to obtain it from elsewhere.

• Option 3 "restore" means to bring something back to an earlier state, which is unrelated to stealing data.

• Option 4 "dispense" means to distribute or give out, the opposite of taking information.

NOTE

• Choose extract when something is deliberately drawn out or obtained from a source, especially in the context of data theft.

question:
Read the following passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in each blank.

As more of our daily transactions move online, protecting personal data ____1____ become a matter of individual responsibility as much as national policy. Cybercriminals constantly devise new methods of deception, ____2____ phishing emails and fraudulent links that mimic legitimate websites. A single careless click can allow malicious software to infiltrate a device and ____3____ sensitive information such as passwords and bank details. Experts therefore advise users to update their software regularly, avoid unfamiliar downloads, and enable two-factor authentication wherever possible. Organisations, too, must invest in firewalls and encryption ____4____ their networks remain resilient against attack. Yet technology alone cannot guarantee safety; ultimately, cybersecurity depends ____5____ the vigilance of ordinary users who must learn to recognise suspicious activity before it causes irreversible harm.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. so that.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• So that introduces a clause of purpose, explaining why organisations invest in firewalls and encryption — namely, to keep networks resilient (ताकि)

◦ Example: The company backs up its files daily so that no data is lost in a crash.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

Additional Information

• Option 1 "even though" signals concession or contrast, not purpose, and does not fit the logical link intended.

• Option 3 "in case" suggests a precaution against a possible future event, which is close but less precise than the direct purpose expressed by "so that".

• Option 4 "as though" introduces a comparison of manner (as if), which is unrelated to purpose.

NOTE

• Use so that to link an action with its intended purpose or result; reserve "in case" for precautions against a possibility.

Cybercriminals constantly devise new methods of deception, ____2____ phishing emails and fraudulent links that mimic legitimate websites. A single careless click can allow malicious software to infiltrate a device and ____3____ sensitive information such as passwords and bank details. Experts therefore advise users to update their software regularly, avoid unfamiliar downloads, and enable two-factor authentication wherever possible. Organisations, too, must invest in firewalls and encryption ____4____ their networks remain resilient against attack. Yet technology alone cannot guarantee safety; ultimately, cybersecurity depends ____5____ the vigilance of ordinary users who must learn to recognise suspicious activity before it causes irreversible harm.

Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. on.

IMPORTANT POINTS

• Depends on is the fixed preposition collocation meaning to rely on or be determined by something, here the vigilance of users (पर निर्भर करता है)

◦ Example: The success of the harvest depends on timely and adequate rainfall.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4.

Additional Information

• Option 1 "at" is not used with "depend" in standard English.

• Option 2 "for" is used with verbs like "wait for" or "account for", not with "depend".

• Option 3 "with" does not form a standard collocation with "depend" in this sense.

NOTE

• Memorise fixed preposition pairings such as depend on, rely on, and insist on, since these cannot be swapped for other prepositions.
